name: PreferenceRanker
tagline: The Preference Ranker lets a person choose their favourite options from a list and put them in order, most preferred first.
description: The Preference Ranker lets a person choose their favourite options from a list and put them in order, most preferred first. It replaces separate "first choice / second choice / third choice" drop-downs with one clear, touch-friendly field that cannot hold the same option twice.
features: Searchable option list with optional categories and short descriptions
Ranking list with numbers, drag handles, move up / down / remove buttons and Alt+arrow keys
Minimum and maximum number of choices, with required slots and clear messages
Undo after removing a choice or clearing the list
Saves the ranking in one text column and tells the app the number of choices, the top choice and whether the field is valid
